parsed.description: 可复制的 R2 课程工作区；真实消费共享导航、ConnectedSurface、Workspace 和已有课程资源管理树。
useWhen: 以课程身份、公共资源/班级范围和编辑树为主任务的原型。
doNotUseWhen: 活动批改、回放工作区、完整 S1-S6 控制器或生产课程后台。
props: R2Recipe: editor?: ReactNode; instanceId?: string; visibleLimit?: 3|4|5; connection?: inset|merged.
Defaults: generated stable instanceId, cap4, inset, existing Tree/ManageTree course-resource editor.
slots: editor replaces the content editor without replacing navigation.
variants: one R2 mock fixture; compact/expanded/hidden local demonstration controls.
states: term-menu-open: existing DropdownMenu; only current mock semester, no cross-semester service
dependencies: ScopeNavigation, Sidebar, Tree, ManageTree Pattern, Breadcrumb, Button, IconButton, Avatar, Tag, Tooltip, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Popover, FormItem, Input, Select
tokens: --rain-local-r2-* aliases preserve this reference fixture; never promote these to global defaults.
Review-01: background-neutral-3; fill-neutral-alpha-6 hover; text-brand-1 active rail; text-neutral-5 semester; text-neutral-6 nonessential explanations.
layoutConstraints: 1440×800 default reference artboard; 1200/1600 can be selected in Playground.
Recipe owns finite workspace height and editor scrollport; internal UI component styling stays scoped.
compositionRules: Copy r2.tsx, course-resources.tsx, r2.css and its type declaration together; include registry/tree.json#manage-tree; retain source/version and record your instance modifications.
For the standalone consumer, include consumer.css and its declaration; adjust Tailwind source scanning paths for the target directory.

ManageTree owns complete structural drafts and field buffers; filters only project visible nodes. CourseResources owns the local committed snapshot and temporary-key mapping. Save does not publish or contact a service.
accessibility: Reuse shared Sidebar, Tree, Dialog and Split keyboard/focus behavior.
Keep header identity and stable recovery controls available when hiding navigation.
antiPatterns: Describing the mock as a production course application.
Copying the approved HTML body or script into the candidate route.
